Meet on arrival and transfer to Choroní. Check in at a posada hotel, have dinner and rest.

Pueblo Choroní is a small coastal fishing town. Here the Caribbean Sea meets the tropical mountains of Henri Pittier National Park, known for its rich bird diversity. From Choroní, you can walk to beaches, waterfalls and lagoons, or explore the historic centre on foot.

Meals: dinner.
